tiles.markdownText:
# PKeyAuth SubmitUrl enforcement rollout

**1% (48h) -> 5% (48h) -> 25% (72h) -> 50% (72h) -> 100%.**

Set Stage and the actual ECS stage-start UTC timestamp. Gates use their own trailing 48/72h window, bounded by stage start; trend tiles use the time picker. Missing data is not a pass. Expected REJECTED_* blocks are measured separately from allowed-only parent health.

**100% reference:** frozen, aggregate-only shadow data from 2026-10-28 UTC. Matching app/host/caller keys required; <95% coverage holds promotion. Cloud=false means not validated/unknown, not proof of malicious traffic. Counts are sampled telemetry, not installed-device prevalence.

# Segment and outcome diagnostics

Use caller / broker host / app-version filters before promotion. HasMismatch=true parents are intentionally excluded from the compatibility gate. Parent statuses and sampled repeats are directional proxies, not end-to-end success or proven retry loops. No URLs, hosts, nonces, credentials or device identifiers are returned.

    | join kind=leftouter hint.strategy=broadcast Parents on trace_id, ParentId
